points.statement: Agent memory is transformed from inference-time retrieval into parameter-resident skills internalized through experience.
points.quote: We present PEAM, a Parametric Embodied Agent Memory framework in Minecraft that transforms agent memory from inference-time retrieval into parameter-resident skills internalized through experience.

points.statement: A slow deliberative model for open-ended reasoning is paired with a fast parametric module that reflexively executes consolidated skills.
points.quote: PEAM pairs a slow deliberative LLM for open-ended reasoning with a fast parametric module for reflexive execution of consolidated skills.

points.statement: The fast module is a multimodal mixture-of-experts adapter architecture with physically isolated per-category adapters, enabling parameter-level continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.
points.quote: The fast module is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts LoRA architecture with per-category physically isolated adapters, enabling parameter-level continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.

points.statement: Failure is treated as a training signal: failure–correction trajectory pairs are internalized through a joint behavioral-cloning and contrastive objective.
points.quote: We treat failure as a first-class training signal: failure–correction trajectory pairs are internalized through a joint behavioral-cloning and contrastive objective, so the agent learns not only what succeeds but also how corrected actions differ from failed ones.

points.statement: A parameterization-worthiness score decides which experience to internalize, and a scale-free self-triggered consolidation decides when, without task-specific hand-tuned thresholds.
points.quote: To govern consolidation, PEAM introduces a parameterization-worthiness score for deciding which experience should be internalized, and a scale-free self-triggered consolidation mechanism for deciding when to internalize without task-specific hand-tuned thresholds, making the agent self-evolving as the trigger transfers across task distributions without re-tuning.

points.statement: A slow deliberative model explores, verifies, and produces corrected trajectories, which are staged in episodic memory.
points.quote: A slow deliberative LLM explores, verifies, and produces corrected trajectories, which are staged in episodic memory.

points.statement: The gap is a missing consolidation pathway: external memory supports recall but does not specify how selected experience becomes parametric competence.
points.quote: We view this as a missing consolidation pathway rather than a failure of retrieval-augmented memory itself: external memory supports recall, but it does not by itself specify how selected experience becomes part of the agent’s parametric competence.

points.statement: Contrastive parametric consolidation is suggested to be best suited to action-space failures with code-level corrections.
points.quote: This suggests that contrastive parametric consolidation is best suited to action-space failures with code-level corrections.

points.statement: When paired real-environment collection is bounded by exploration ceilings, re-slicing an existing trajectory pool along categorical axes substitutes for cross-distribution stability evaluation.
points.quote: When paired real-environment collection is bounded by exploration ceilings, re-slicing an existing trajectory pool along categorical axes provides a tractable substitute for cross-distribution stability evaluation, with explicit acknowledgment of the synthetic-versus-real gap.
